text:
jordana: quick heads-up — sampleapp hit a dim mismatch in staging. Sent a batch of 512-dim embeddings to /rerank and got a dim_mismatch.

mike: can you paste the request/response (sanitized)? wondering if the batch helper changed shapes. :thinking_face: 

jordana: sanitized: {"requests": [{"id": "q1", "embedding": [0.12, 0.03, ... /* 512 floats */]}], "model": "open-embed-lite-512"} 
server: {"error": "dim_mismatch", "got": 512, "expected": 768, "help": "use model open-embed-lite-768 or send X-Embedding-Dim header"}

sam: config drift + parity. sampleapp defaulted to a 512 quantized variant but rerank pipeline is pinned to 768. Also note: Node SDK auto-pads in some clients; Python errors. That's a DX footgun.

lina: agreed. propose small devex checklist: (1) SDKs surface model.metadata.embedding_dim consistently, (2) batch helper validates dims by default (fail-fast), (3) provide opt-in pad_mode or trim_mode, (4) add Idempotency-Key on batch sends.

mike: short-term patch: add a client-side dim-check in the batch helper and a compatibility shim that normalizes `vector`/`embedding`/`embeddings` fields. Server-side: accept optional header `X-Embedding-Dim` and return machine-friendly error with candidates.

jordana: i'll open a sampleapp PR with the dim validator + a failing integration test that simulates 512->768 mismatch. include a curl example showing X-Embedding-Dim.

sam: also watch out for the retry behavior: our retrier re-sent whole batches on socket timeouts without idempotency keys and we got duplicate scoring. important to add Idempotency-Key and dedupe on server.

lina: i'll draft a short SDK spec that defines error semantics, pad_mode, and default idempotency. plan for a small patch release with telemetry before flipping the stricter behavior on.

devx-bot: Created DEVEX-3301 "embed dim validation + idempotency + field normalization" and linked this thread.

mike: thanks. one more UX nit: standardize response naming to `embedding` (single) / `embeddings` (batch) across SDKs — add compatibility accessors in the sampleapp for now.

jordana: resolving for now. will ping when PR & tests land. :thumbsup:
